Ram Mandir donation theft case sparks political debate and legal scrutiny

An alleged theft of donations at the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya has led to a political controversy and ongoing police investigation. Lawyers in Ayodhya have reportedly refused to represent the accused, citing legal and ethical concerns. The incident has drawn criticism from opposition leaders and prompted calls for transparency regarding the temple's finances.
